title: Двойное разоблачение в больнице  (Double Exposure at the Hospital)

segments.t: In the decoy hospital room, Vika tenderly tells Max that she wants them to be together, only for the real patient assigned to that bed to walk in and kick Max out. Minutes later, Vika walks into Max's actual room and comes face to face with Sasha, exposing Max's double game to both women at once.
Виктория Сергеевна, а вы что здесь делаете?
Он правда сейчас вышел на процедуры.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Oh, stop it, Max.' Vika offers an emphatic bearing in their talk, using "perestan" (from "perestat", "stop") alongside "da" ("yes") to shape the meaning.
'I have thought a lot about us.' Vika displays an earnest attitude during the exchange, weaving "mnogo" ("a lot") together with "dumala" ("thought") just the way native speakers do.
'I decided that we...' Vika favors an earnest tack at once, linking "reshila" ("decided"), "ya" ("I"), and "chto" ("what") in one brisk exchange.
'I already had my procedure.' Max maintains a steady mood for Vika, anchoring the Russian line on "uzhe" ("already, now") and "delal" ("were doing") without extra filler.
'Well, that was yesterday.' Barinov takes a sharp approach straight away, weaving "bylo" ("was") together with "vchera" ("yesterday") just the way native speakers do.
'Vika, I am sorry.' Max maintains a brisk style at once, combining "izvini" ("sorry, excuse me") and "vika" ("Vika") so the key meaning lands right away.
'Excuse me, that is not your bed.' Max chooses a pointed bearing beside Barinov, pairing "prostite" ("excuse me") with "mesto" ("place, post") to get the point across in plain spoken Russian.
'What do you mean it is not mine?' Barinov asks honestly in this moment, building the phrase around "kak" ("how") and "ne" ("not") for a crisp, natural delivery.
Виктория Сергеевна, а вы что здесь делаете?
'Viktoriya Sergeyevna, what are you doing here?' Max checks warmly as the beat lands, linking "zdes" ("here"), "delayete" ("are doing"), and "viktoriya" ("Victoria") in one brisk exchange.
'What am I doing here?' Max quizzes warmly as the beat lands, linking "zdes" ("here"), "delayu" ("I make"), and "ya" ("I") in one brisk exchange.
'What are you doing here?' Barinov wonders openly as the talk turns, combining "zdes" ("here") and "delayesh" ("are you doing") so the key meaning lands right away.
'I came to visit Max.' Vika takes a resolute attitude at once, linking "prishla" ("came"), "ya" ("I"), and "maksu" ("Max") in one brisk exchange.
Он правда сейчас вышел на процедуры.
'Though right now he stepped out for his procedures.' Max displays an honest line at this moment, combining "pravda" ("honestly") and "seychas" ("now") so the key meaning lands right away.
Виктория Сергеевна, а вы что здесь делаете?
Он правда сейчас вышел на процедуры.

That wraps up this scene as the real occupant of the decoy hospital bed returns and kicks Max out, causing Vika and Sasha to run into each other in Max's real ward and discover his double game. See you next time!
